cohort: 120 patients with previous caesarean deliveries admitted at N.R.S Medical College & Hospital, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
finding: Women with a prior caesarean section are at an increased risk of having a repeat caesarean section.
mod_finding: Of the 20 patients who attempted vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC), 60% of their babies were admitted to the NICU, and 70% of the babies had a delayed cry.
